definitions.full: H2064. zabad [ זָבַד ] verb bestow upon, endow with (Arabic ; Aramaic זְבַד , Gen 30:20 , dowry ; in Sabean proper name, see below זָבָד below; also in Palmyrene proper name נבוזבד Vog 73and many others ( זבדבל זבדעתא, זבידא, זבדא, זבד, = Ζαβδιβηλος , etc.): see Eut Sechs Inschr. aus Idalien p. 15 ), טוֺב זֶבֶד אֹתִי אלהים זְבָדַנִי 30:20 a (E), apparently in explanation of name Zebulun, compare Thes Di; another explanation in v b, see below זבל .
